label: Horlicks
note: Began as Horlick’s Infant and Invalids Food (1873); UK recipe lists malted wheat 46 %, malted barley 26 %, wheat flour, dried whey, dried skimmed milk. Largest market India, where it is a breakfast drink; Unilever owns it outside the UK

about.text: British-American malted milk powder for a hot drink, first sold as an infant and invalid food. The brand began with the Horlick brothers in Chicago in 1873.
